page.overview:
What is Hall of Miraculous Mist?

The is the dwelling place of the Jade Emperor.

The doors to the Hall of Miraculous Mist are jade and studded with gold, with phoenixes frequently dancing in front of them. The interior walls are coloured a majestic purple and intricately carved with images of dragons and phoenixes soaring. In the centre of the room stands crystal dishes filled with magic pills and agate jars with coral trees growing out of them.
